findings.description: Popular products query has no index or cache — Every call triggers a full collection scan sorted by soldCount. Add productSchema.index({ soldCount: -1 }) in Product.js. Consider caching the top 10 for 5-10 minutes.

Webhook race condition for soldCount — If two payment_intent.succeeded webhooks arrive before the first DB write completes, both could match isPaid: false and increment soldCount twice. Consider storing processed webhook event IDs.

Deleted product between order and payment — If a product is deleted before payment confirms, incrementSoldCount fails silently (logged but soldCount won't update). Payment succeeds. This is acceptable but worth documenting.
